# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release of Tuple (available from [tuple.live](https://tuple.live)) is supported. Please update to the latest version before reporting.

## Reporting a problem

Please **do not** open a public issue for security-sensitive reports. Instead, use one of these private channels:

- Email **c0re_m4l@proton.me**, or
- GitHub's private reporting: the repository's **Security** tab → **Report a vulnerability**.

Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and the impact. The maintainer will acknowledge your report within a few days and keep you posted on the resolution.

For anything that isn't security-sensitive, please use [Discord](https://discord.gg/skn5Np6DdP) or a regular [issue](https://github.com/c0remusic/tuple/issues).
